subject: Post-call: data handling & partner/vendor mapping — next steps
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@fintechco.com>, Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@marketplace.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call: data handling & partner/vendor mapping — next steps

Hi Elena / Jamal — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can move the procurement and security review along.

Recap (call notes)
- Primary use: FintechCo will call Redwood hosted API (text/classification/embeddings) for transaction enrichment and risk scoring.
- Data types: transaction metadata + customer identifiers (account_id, email hash, merchant_id). You indicated some telemetry events are sent to the marketplace onboarding flow.
- Risk/requirement high-level: PII minimization, US data residency for production, detailed audit logs, and a DPA + SOC 2 review.

Open clarifications we need from you
1) Definitive list of fields you consider PII (example: does account_id and transaction_id count as PII for you?).
2) Retention targets per class (full logs vs anonymized analytics). You mentioned shorter retention for identifiable logs — please confirm days.
3) Which telemetry vendors / marketplace flows receive event-level data (names + contact) vs aggregated metrics?
4) Any mandatory encryption/KMS requirements (HSM-backed keys, BYOK)?

What Redwood can offer (short):
- Per-tenant data residency (we can pin to us-east-1; EU-only also possible for future phases).
- KMS integrations (customer-managed keys via AWS KMS) and field-level tokenization options.
- Audit log retention configurable; default is 90 days for full request logs and 365 days for anonymized metrics, but we can extend with an add-on.
- Marketplace flows: we support restricted telemetry channels for marketplace onboarding; sensitive fields can be filtered before forwarding.

Requested next steps & timeline
- Can you share FintechCo's security profile and a list of third-party subprocessors involved in onboarding (e.g., analytics, logging, CDN)? (Attachment: redwood-data-handling-checklist.pdf + redwood-dpa-draft.docx attached for reference)
- If OK, copy your security/infra contact on the next thread so we can set a technical deep-dive this week.
- Proposed times for a 45-min security call: Wed 11/4 09:00-12:00 PT or Thu 11/5 13:00-16:00 PT. Please confirm preferred slot.

Thanks — will assemble a short mapping doc once we have the PII fields + retention windows.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood-data-handling-checklist.pdf (summary), redwood-dpa-draft.docx (editable DPA)
From: Elena Rossi <elena@fintechco.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@marketplace.io>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 16:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: data handling & partner/vendor mapping — next steps

Hi Neha — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side that should help you and legal: 

1) PII scope: we consider the following PII: customer_email (hashed or tokenized accepted), account_id (internal id), card_suffix (last 4 digits) and any identifier that can directly map to a natural person. transaction_id is sensitive when combined with account_id — if transaction_id is stored without account_id we treat it as pseudonymous.

2) Retention: for production logs we are targeting 30 days for identifiable request logs, 365 days for aggregated/anonymized analytics. Security/audit logs (access events) should be retained for 12 months.

3) Telemetry & marketplace flows: our marketplace onboarding (Marketplace.io) receives only non-identifying telemetry (event type, timestamp, success/failure) plus a pseudo-tenant id. Full request payloads containing PII are NOT forwarded to Marketplace.io. Jamal is the contact for the marketplace flow.

4) Subprocessors: short list is attached (fintechco-security-profile.pdf). Primary vendors: Segment (analytics), Sentry (error telemetry), Datadog (metrics/alerts). Segment receives only event-level telemetry; it does not receive full request payloads with PII.

5) KMS: we prefer BYOK (customer-managed AWS KMS) for production; HSM requirement only for payments-sensitive environments (not for initial PoC).

I'll drop in Jamal to confirm marketplace details. We'll aim to get a security contact on the call — probably our infra lead.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Product, FintechCo
elena@fintechco.com

Attachment: fintechco-security-profile.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@fintechco.com>, Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@marketplace.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: data handling & partner/vendor mapping — next steps

Thanks Elena — very helpful. Looping in Rishi (security/legal) and Marissa (solutions) so we can turn this into an actionable checklist and proposed config.

Quick notes / follow-ups from Redwood side:
- We'll prepare a mapping doc showing: field -> PII? -> retention -> forward-to-marketplace? -> encryption-at-rest/key-owner. Expect a first draft by EOD Tue 11/3.
- For the PoC we can enable: US-only residency (us-east-1), customer-managed KMS (BYOK), and redact customer_email unless you opt into hashed email for enrichment features.
- Regarding the reported subprocessors (Segment, Sentry, Datadog): please confirm whether any of them will receive raw PII-containing payloads for your environment. Our gating rule is: no third party may receive raw PII without a signed DPA + subprocessors addendum.

Proposed next call (technical deep-dive): Thu 11/5 14:00 PT — please confirm. I'll attach the DPA redlines and a short checklist for the call.

Best,
Neha

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@fintechco.com>, Jamal Ortiz <jamal.ortiz@marketplace.io>

Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:45:00 +0000
Subject: Redwood: data handling checklist & requested artifacts

Hi Elena / Jamal — Rishi here (Redwood legal & security). Appreciate the context; a few concrete items we need to move to legal review and to finalize the PoC scope. Please respond inline or attach docs where possible.

1) PII field confirmation: a canonical list of fields you classify as PII (csv or spreadsheet preferred). Example columns: field_name, sample_value_format, pii_yes_no.

2) Retention windows: please confirm retention days for each class: identifiable_request_logs, pseudonymous_request_logs, aggregated_metrics, audit_access_logs. Our suggested defaults (for reference): 30 / 365 / 365 / 365.

3) Logging & audit controls: confirm who needs admin access to request logs and audit trails, and whether you require push-based SIEM forwarding (we support Datadog/BigQuery/Splunk exports). Also confirm expected audit log retention (you indicated 12 months).

4) Certifications / evidence: SOC 2 report (latest), penetration test summary, any required compliance attestation. We can share Redwood's SOC 2 once we have an NDA or as part of the DPA exchange.

5) Subprocessor roster: list each subprocessor and a short role description (e.g., Segment - analytics event stream; Datadog - metrics and alerts). Critical ask: confirm which subprocessors, if any, will receive raw PII. If none, note N/A.

6) Data residency: confirm whether production must be US-only (us-east-1) and whether backups or logs can be replicated to EU for DR.

7) Contractual: please review the attached DPA redlines (dpa-redlines-annotated.pdf) and indicate any must-have clauses for you (e.g., 3rd party audit right, subprocessor notification window). We can push a DocuSign link once items 1–6 are confirmed.

Deliverables from Redwood: annotated mapping doc + proposed infra config (KMS, encryption-in-transit, redaction rules) by EOD Wed 11/4 once we receive the PII list.

If we can get the PII spreadsheet and subprocessor roster today, we can have legal attach the DPA to DocuSign tomorrow and schedule the tech deep-dive on Thu.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachments: dpa-redlines-annotated.pdf
